definition.zh-TW: 營運槓桿度乘以財務槓桿度，看營業收入變動時稅前淨利總共會放大多少倍。倍數越高，獲利對景氣越敏感。
definition.en: The degree of operating leverage multiplied by the degree of financial leverage: how many times more profit before tax moves when revenue moves. A higher degree means profit is more sensitive to the business cycle.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
